note: Jasper National Park campground just off the Icefields Parkway at the base of the Wilcox day hike, down the road from the Columbia Icefield; primitive sites with fire pits, kitchen shelters and food lockers. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 46 primitive sites, first-come only, rigs under 27 ft, water and sani-dump on the map. Wrote season Jun 10 - Sep 28 (2026), booking (FCFS, 14-night max), sites, facilities; note rewritten. PIN IS ~111 km WRONG (stored 51.2183 in BC backcountry; campground at 52.2189,-117.1762) and elevation follows the bad pin.
flags: PIN MOVE (major): stored 51.21830,-117.18500 is about 111 km south of the campground, in roadless forest in BC (Esri imagery shows no road or campground there); the latitude is off by one degree. The campground is at 52.2189,-117.1762 (centre of the site loops on Esri imagery north of the Icefields Parkway; Google's 'Wilcox Creek Campground' pin 52.21896,-117.17570). Recommend location 52.2189,-117.1762. ELEVATION: stored 2021 m matches the wrong pin (Open-Meteo DEM 2012 m there); at the corrected pin the DEM gives 2066 m - re-fetch on the move.

PHONE (stored empty): Google lists +1 877-737-3783, which is the Parks Canada Reservation Service number (the agency row's booking note), not a campground line; no campground-specific phone found. Leave empty or use the Jasper visitor line if the curator prefers.
